mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5%, it signals severe labor market distress that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE > 9.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) below their 12-month lows signal a synchronized demand and supply contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO are below 12-month lows, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) and low-inflation environment (CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0%), the Federal Reserve's accommodative stance supports equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS <= 0.2% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 340,000 million dollars, it signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with RSAFS > 340000, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 9.0%), a month-over-month decline in the unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with UNRATE > 9.0% and UNRATE decline, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in year-over-year inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) signal a shift toward a growth-oriented monetary policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
